svg.title: GPIO toggle in C: every layer
svg.text: GPIO toggle in C: every layer
What gpio-blink-uapi.c (Path A) and gpio-blink-gpiod.c (Path B) do at each layer, down to the USR3 LED on our BeagleBone
Path A = <linux/gpio.h> directly (kernel interface v2) Path B = libgpiod 1.6 (kernel interface v1)
2. Reserve it as an output (start low)

svg.text: holds it at 0 V: LED off

text.tspan: Both paths meet at the system call:
Path A speaks the kernel's v2 interface, libgpiod 1.6 the older v1; below that, everything is identical.
Only phase 4 turns the pin back into an input.
Holding the line handle open (phases 2→4) is what makes toggling glitch-free.
a failing system call returns -1 and sets
